t: Normal attack (Forces only) summons an ally Hildelt beside you, or sends it at the enemy you target. It has an Ultimate Hildelt's stats and fights with Hildelt's own attacks.

It follows you and fights the nearest enemy in the room until it is defeated or you change area. After a defeat you can summon again in 3 seconds. An HP bar shows over every summon, and a summon that blocks your view of your character turns half transparent.

00090B.d: A memory of a lost daughter. Now turned into a weapon.

t: Normal and heavy attacks fire a fast light beam along the ground out to Rifle range. It pierces enemies and boxes, stops at walls, and can hit enemies that block gunfire, such as Satellite Lizards.
Light bursts along its path hit up to 5 enemies once more for 50% of the beam's damage. Heavy beams also leave a ground wake for 2 seconds that hits every 0.25 seconds for 30%.
Special: five Lv.30 Barta in a 40-degree fan freeze every enemy they hit, unless it is immune.
Heavy and special attacks cannot combo, and your techniques deal 10% more damage while it is equipped.

t: Normal attacks are fast slashes at 1.8x attack speed that hit up to 2 enemies.
Heavy and special attacks fire three photon bullets, straight ahead and about 12 degrees to each side, out to 130 units. Each bullet aims at its own target and deals 35% less damage.
The special attack's bullets carry the weapon's special.

so.t: Dropped by the Crater machines on Hard and Very Hard depending on the machine and Section ID, and by Gravit S7 on Ultimate.

000A0B.d: A legendary weapon created to deal with a battalion.

t: Normal and heavy attacks whip the flail at one enemy from a distance. Each landed hit also sets off a Lv.20 Rafoie that deals 30% of its usual damage to up to 5 enemies in the blast.
Each landed hit costs 1% of maximum TP, rounded up. You can still attack with no TP.
Special: the ball circles you three times over 2 seconds, and each turn hits up to 5 enemies within 153 units at normal-attack power.

With Ogre/Power++ equipped: the weapon's hits deal 20% more damage, your attack techniques deal 10% more (its Rafoie blasts too), and each landed hit costs 0.5% of maximum TP instead of 1%. Ogre/Power and Ogre/Power+ do not count.

so.t: Equip Club and use Berserker's Horn on it from your inventory; it becomes Ogre's Explosion.

0102AB.d: Spinning charms of good luck. They empower Hitogata and Dancing Hitogata. Only Forces can use it.

t: With Hitogata or Dancing Hitogata equipped: +25 ATA, and Gifoie, Gibarta, Gizonde, Rafoie, Rabarta and Razonde deal 25% more damage.

With Dancing Hitogata, its spinning ring lasts 15 seconds longer (20 seconds from one attack, up to 45 seconds left when you keep attacking) and is 1.5x wider (60 units for normal attacks, 90 for heavy attacks).

030E2B.d: The soul of Heathcliff Flowen. Use it on an equipped Dark Flow to purify the sword.

000D0B.d: Golden claws from another world, one for each hand. Its special attack is the art Sougocho Sekka.
ef: Claw attacks reach two targets. Normal combo hits restore 2% / 4% / 6% maximum TP; heavy attacks restore twice as much.
Special attack: Sougocho Sekka, a four-strike dash that hits up to 5 enemies. It costs 45 TP, or half your HP for androids.

With the El Dorado set: gold claws and a gold Sougocho Sekka. Each strike leaves a spinning afterimage for 5 seconds (10% power), and each combo swing leaves a dimensional cut for 5 seconds (10% power, up to 3 at a time). Each one hits up to 5 enemies. Neither the afterimages nor the cuts stagger enemies.

so.t: Field of Caelum: boxes in the boss arenas, 1 in 4,000, any difficulty. Rare boosts do not change it.
